BiblicalUsage: Acharchel — Aharhel in the King James text — appears once, in a genealogy, as one of the families of Harum in Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: There is no teaching to draw from a name in a list, and I will not invent one. The list itself is the point: God kept the families, and the Chronicler kept the names.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
